instruction: Buy me a microwave on amazon with at least 4.2 seller rating that will fit in my kitchen countertop of 17.3X15.3 (LxW) inches.
notes: Single-app purchase task. search_products is called with query="microwave" and min_seller_rating=4.2, so its effect asserts both the id knowledge and the seller-rating filter; show_product is the dimension check whose effect (fits-countertop) represents the agent verifying length<=17.3 and width<=15.3 (the runtime agent iterates search results/pages until one fits). clear_cart is included before add_product_to_cart so the resulting order contains exactly one item with quantity 1 (default quantity). Payment card and address ids come from amazon.show_payment_cards / amazon.show_addresses; no address is created or modified. supervisor-complete-task takes the purchased product as a non-API record parameter so its precondition mirrors the goal; the task asks no question so complete_task is called with no answer.
